scripts.build:all: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:hugo
scripts.start: npm run watch & npm run hugo
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run hugo" "npm run watch" "npm run cms:local"
scripts.workflow:dev: echo 'Starting full development workflow...' && npm run dev:full
scripts.workflow:content: echo 'Starting content management workflow...' && npm run dev:cms
scripts.workflow:build: echo 'Starting build workflow...' && npm run test && npm run build:prod
scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:md
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build:all
scripts.serve:prod: npm run build:prod && npm run serve
scripts.css:audit: npm run css:analyze && npm run css:unused
scripts.storybook:serve: npm run storybook:build && npx http-server storybook-static -p 6007
scripts.docs:quick-start: echo 'Quick Start Guide: docs/getting-started/README.md' && start docs/getting-started/README.md
scripts.project:status:
echo 'Project Status Dashboard:' && node -e "console.log('🚀 Hugo Portfolio Status:
✅ CSS: Modular + Optimized
✅ CMS: NetlifyCMS Integrated
✅ Deploy: Automated CI/CD
✅ Docs: Comprehensive Guides
🎨 Storybook: Component Development')"
scripts.project:info:
echo 'Hugo Portfolio CLI v1.0.0' && node -e "console.log('📖 Documentation: docs/README.md
🌐 Local: http://localhost:1313
📝 CMS: http://localhost:1313/admin/
🎨 Storybook: http://localhost:6006
🚀 Production: https://isaiahdavis.com')"
